context_for_next_testing_agent: Weekly Leaderboard endpoint fully tested. GET /api/leaderboard/weekly returns: leaderboard array (sorted by consistencyPoints desc), myRank (int or null), myEntry (object with user's own stats or null), totalParticipants. Each leaderboard entry contains: userId, fullName, role, avatar, currentStreak, longestStreak, consistencyPoints, totalSessions, totalMinutes, streakLevel, rank. Admin users are excluded from leaderboard but can access the endpoint. Limit query parameter works (default 20). Authentication required (401 without token). Regression tests passed for: /api/streaks/me (works for trainers and trainees), /api/trainee/achievements (12 badges), /api/admin/dashboard, /api/admin/sessions (enriched), /api/admin/message.
